what_changed:
- Add Folder Sync settings tab: watch a local folder and auto-upload photos/videos to Immich on Windows, macOS, and Linux.
- Option to upload only when Immich is reachable on the local network; unsynced files still appear in Library with an unsaved badge.
- Sync status icons for saved, saving, unsaved, and error saving (Lucide-style cloud icons).
- Cut idle/tray RAM: smaller thumbnail/preview caches, drop decoded tiles off-screen and when hidden, trim the Windows working set in tray.
- Media tiles no longer keep a second scaled pixmap copy (was roughly doubling timeline image memory).
- Explore person gallery scrolls and matches Library layout; face hero loads from cache.
- Rebuilt Snap packages against current Ubuntu security updates (USN-8699-1 libssh, USN-8709-1 ncurses, USN-8724-1 rabbitmq-c).
